items.headline: 俄軍飛彈猛轟基輔
items.context: 俄羅斯對基輔等多座烏克蘭城市發動大規模飛彈與無人機攻擊，至少8人死亡、數十人受傷。同一時間，烏克蘭也持續對俄羅斯境內基礎設施發動反擊。
items.thread_text:
俄羅斯對基輔等烏克蘭城市發動一輪大規模飛彈與無人機攻擊，至少8人死亡，數十人受傷。這波攻擊被形容是近期規模較大的一次。烏克蘭並未坐等——同一時間也持續對俄羅斯境內的基礎設施發動自己的攻勢。雙方你來我往，戰事沒有降溫的跡象。

items.context: 網紅安德魯・泰特（Andrew Tate）與弟弟崔斯坦・泰特（Tristan Tate）在美國邁阿密被捕。英國當局對兩人提出38項新罪名，包括強姦與性販運，並要求引渡。
items.thread_text:

items.thread_text:

sources.summary: The soul-rockers achieved worldwide success before surprising everyone by deciding to quit while they were ahead. Now they’re back with a new album railing against the state of contemporary America In the autumn of 2024, Alabama Shakes showed no sign of ending their indefinite hiatus – and nobody was asking them to. Seven years had passed since the blues-soul-rock band, who exploded out of Athens, Alabama in 2009, had last shared a stage. Their transatlantic Top 10 2012 debut Boys & Girls announced them; the million-selling 2015 follow-up Sound & Color went to No 1 in the US and won them four Grammys. Their fanbase included Bruce Springsteen, Robert Plant and Barack Obama. But by 2017 they were physically and creatively spent, and they stopped. Then, in December 2024, with almost no warning, they played their first show in more than seven years. “We had a friend in Tuscaloosa who had a brewery, but it wasn’t doing so well after Covid,” explains singer Brittany Howard. “He called me and said he was going to do a fundraiser and asked if I’d like to perform. I said, ‘For sure.’” But then she started reminiscing, remembering how that particular friend had been a huge help to the band, not just her personally. She felt the band owed him something, collectively. “So I called the fellas,” she smiles. “‘Do y’all wanna perform at this thing – like, all of us, together?’ And they instantly said yes.” Continue reading...

items.headline: 愛爾蘭奧斯卡影后辭世
items.context: 愛爾蘭女演員 Brenda Fricker 於81歲辭世。她是首位獲得奧斯卡獎的愛爾蘭女性，1989年以《我的左腳》（My Left Foot）中飾演 Daniel Day-Lewis 母親一角獲獎。她也曾在BBC醫療劇《急診室》（Casualty）中演出護理師 Megan Roach 一角。
items.thread_text:
愛爾蘭女演員 Brenda Fricker 過世了，享壽81歲。她是史上第一位拿下奧斯卡獎的愛爾蘭女性，1989年憑《我的左腳》裡飾演 Daniel Day-Lewis 母親的角色獲獎。在那之前，她因主演BBC醫療劇《急診室》而走紅，飾演護理師 Megan Roach，是劇中急診室的「大地之母」，演滿前五季（1986到1990年）。當年的製作人 Geraint Morris 說，這個角色的設定就是要讓每個人都能對她說出心事。

—— 本則來自 The Guardian，2026年7月19日發佈，讓圖書館員翻譯給你聽。

items.headline: AI是否有意識引討論
items.context: 英國《衛報》一篇文章探討AI是否可能有意識。Anthropic今年一月為其AI模型Claude發布新「憲法」，文中提到公司不想誇大、但也不願直接否定Claude具備「道德地位」的可能性。一個月後，Anthropic執行長Dario Amodei在podcast上更直言，公司無法排除Claude具有意識的可能。
items.thread_text:
AI有沒有可能已經有意識了？這是《衛報》一篇文章拋出的問題。今年一月，Anthropic為旗下AI模型Claude發布新的「憲法」，裡面寫著公司不想誇大、但也不願直接否定Claude具備「道德地位」的可能性。一個月後，Anthropic執行長Dario Amodei在podcast上說，公司無法排除Claude有意識這個可能性。提出「意識難題」一詞的哲學家David Chalmers甚至說，十年內出現有意識的大型語言模型，機率不小。連Claude自己被問到這個問題時，給出的答案也是5%到40%之間，還特別強調自己也不確定。

—— 本則來自 The Guardian，2026年7月19日發佈，讓圖書館員翻譯給你聽。

sources.summary: Experts believe it’s at least possible. We urgently need a plan to navigate the ethical implications In January, the AI company Anthropic published a new constitution for Claude, its most advanced large language model (LLM), which contained the comment: “We are caught in a difficult position where we neither want to overstate the likelihood of Claude’s moral patienthood nor dismiss it out of hand.” A month later, Anthropic’s CEO Dario Amodei went on a podcast and said his company couldn’t rule out the possibility that Claude was conscious. Philosopher David Chalmers, who coined the phrase “the hard problem of consciousness”, has said there is a significant chance of conscious LLMs within a decade. And what about Claude itself? When asked during testing to estimate the probability that it is a moral patient , meaning that its wellbeing matters in its own right, it gave numbers ranging from 5% to 40% and stressed how uncertain it was. Modern AI systems are extraordinarily complex, and they are advancing fast. In terms of structural complexity and computational scale, by some measures a few are already in the range of a mouse brain, and at recent growth rates, they could reach the range of a human brain within five to 10 years. items.headline: 愛爾蘭新劇探索執念友誼
items.context: 愛爾蘭 Fishamble 劇團的新戲《For Dolores》正在高威（Galway）的 Mick Lally 劇院上演，由劇作家 Eva O'Connor 撰寫。故事描寫兩位二十多歲的年輕人 Mo 與 Réaltín，從愛丁堡大學時期相識，寫出一段夾雜依賴、愛與執念的複雜友誼。

sources.summary: Mick Lally theatre, Galway Eva O’Connor’s intense new play explores the lives of spiky Glaswegian Mo and naive Dubliner Réaltín through competing monologues, blunt humour and dance moves Staying together for the sake of a child takes on additional weight in Eva O’Connor’s intense new play for Fishamble Theatre Company. In their mid-20s, Mo (Catriona Faint) and Réaltín (Lara McDonnell) initially seem like bickering young parents; “chosen family”, attending a therapy session, with the audience in the role of therapist. As the pair’s story spools back to their comical first meeting as new university students in Edinburgh, a portrait of an obsessive friendship emerges. Playwright and actor O’Connor has written previously about compulsion , and here she vividly conveys the confusing mix of love, dependency, admiration and desire that can be poured into young women’s friendships: “the wild magnet pull of us,” Réaltín calls it. Initially it was the contrasts between the spiky, politicised Glaswegian, Mo, and the naive, middle-class Dubliner, Réaltín, that cemented their bond – captured in Faint and McDonnell’s committed, passionate performances. items.context: 《奧德賽》（Odyssey）導演克里斯多福・諾蘭（Christopher Nolan）形容AI是一個「明顯的特洛伊木馬」。他引用特洛伊的典故說：「大家都知道希臘人就在木馬裡面。」

items.headline: 英健康報告估增2%GDP
items.context: 英國智庫Health Foundation發布報告指出，若能把英國民眾的健康水準恢復到2014年的程度，GDP可望成長2%，並為公共財政帶來720億英鎊的收益。報告主張，政策制定者應該把「健康」視為一項經濟資產來看待。
items.thread_text:
英國智庫Health Foundation算了一筆帳：如果能把全英國人的健康水準，恢復到2014年那時候的程度，GDP可以多長2%，公共財政還能多拿到720億英鎊。這份報告在週日發佈，主張政策制定者應該把「健康」當成一項經濟資產來看待，而不只是社福支出。

—— 本則來自 The Guardian，2026年7月19日發佈，讓圖書館員翻譯給你聽。

items.headline: 假冒登入警示詐騙X帳號
items.context: 詐騙集團正利用假冒的「新裝置登入」通知信，針對X（前Twitter）帳號使用者下手，目的是騙走密碼，再拿去做加密貨幣詐騙或釣魚攻擊等後續犯罪。
items.thread_text:
如果你收到一封信，說「你的帳號被新裝置登入了，是你嗎？」——先別急著點連結。這是詐騙集團專門針對X（前Twitter）帳號設計的話術，目的是騙走你的密碼。一旦得手，接下來可能被拿去做加密貨幣詐騙，或是進一步的釣魚攻擊。

—— 本則來自 The Guardian，2026年7月19日發佈，讓圖書館員翻譯給你聽。

items.context: 歐洲理事會秘書長Alain Berset公開批評國際足總（FIFA），說FIFA跟一家預測市場公司的合作案，等於是「給詐欺開了一道門」，同時放任政治力介入，讓世界盃的公正性受到質疑。這封公開信在週日世界盃決賽當天發布。
